title: TRON: Transferring Naturally Evolved Network Architectures into Neuroevolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.35647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) is challenging because of the vast, non-linear space of artificial neural network (ANN) topologies. Evolutionary methods can generate architectures, but their effectiveness is limited by difficulties in preserving functional organization during mutation and recombination. Naturally evolved biological networks may provide organizational principles that support adaptation and evolvability. Here, we introduce TRON (TRansfer Of Natural networks), a neuroevolution framework that uses experimentally characterized protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks as architectural priors. Instead of starting from random topologies, TRON reuses biological interaction patterns as structural building blocks. It combines classical evolutionary operators with neuroevolution-inspired mechanisms, including speciation, and introduces species quarantine to protect newly generated architectures during early maturation. translated_title: TRON：将自然演化的网络架构迁移到神经进化中
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）之所以具有挑战性，是因为人工神经网络（ANN）拓扑空间庞大且呈非线性。进化方法虽然可以生成网络架构，但其有效性受限于在变异和重组过程中难以保持功能组织。自然演化的生物网络或许能提供支持适应性和可进化性的组织原则。本文提出了TRON（TRansfer Of Natural networks，自然网络迁移），这是一个神经进化框架，它以实验表征的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络作为架构先验。TRON不从随机拓扑结构出发，而是复用生物相互作用模式作为结构构建模块。该框架将经典进化算子与受神经进化启发的机制（包括物种形成）相结合，并引入了物种隔离机制，以保护新生成的架构度过早期成熟阶段。我们评估……
tldr: TRON是一个神经进化框架，它将实验表征的蛋白质相互作用网络作为架构先验迁移到神经网络设计中，并结合物种形成与物种隔离机制来改进神经架构搜索。
en_tdlr: TRON is a neuroevolution framework that transfers experimentally characterized protein-protein interaction networks as architectural priors into neural architecture search, combining speciation and species quarantine mechanisms to enhance evolvability.
